measurementMethod: pixel scans of final rest art; prior target coordinates are not pass criteria

coinSlot.note: 2026-09-24 LAMDiceBot: gold coin slot right of the paw emblem, measured on the rest frame (gold outline bbox / dark slit bbox). The coin animation flies to center and is pushed in edge-on; a coin of visible diameter ~29 fits the 32 px slit

rail.method: warm wood top-pixel line fit; rightmost wood component left face

path.method: 2026-09-23 LAMDiceBot: per-column groove (dark line between the beams); capsule bottom sinks 12 px below the groove (hidden by railFront)

machine.crankPivotMethod: round 3: centre of the brass plate bbox (66 px) measured on the rest frame

outletHole.note: dark opening measured on the rest frame (42x34) — the capsule starts here

machine.lip: removed 2026-09-23 — the round-2 lip layer was a mis-cut blob of body/crank plate above the outlet, occluding the rolling capsule. The capsule is always drawn in front of the machine now.

railGroove.note: 2026-09-23: the rail is two parallel beams with a dark groove between them — the ball rolls in the groove, not on the back beam top edge (it looked floating)

railFront.note: 2026-09-23: front beam of the two-beam rail (rows from the per-column groove down 34 px, x 168..415) cut from the rest frame. Draw order while rolling: machine -> capsule -> railFront, so the capsule sits IN the groove and its lower part is hidden

globeBalls.note: 2026-09-24 LAMDiceBot: balls cut from the rest art (pink/green/blue/yellow; purple = blue hue-shift, gold = yellow recolour) + empty glass layer. The game draws the pile itself so balls can tumble while the crank turns; replaces the 3 baked stir frames
globeBalls.orbitNote: safe radius: min glass inner radius ~127 - ball radius 29; horizontal stretch x1.28 in code (globe is wider)

boundary.note: glass inner edge: distance from center per 5 deg (0 deg = +x, clockwise in screen coords), from the eroded glass mask

chute.note: 2026-09-24 LAMDiceBot edit (user sketch): brass pipe from the glass floor down into the body right above the outlet hole (x 161). The picked ball shrinks into the hole and drops in; the capsule then comes out of the outlet. Hole painted on globe-empty, pipe on the rest frame; ball-bottom fringe under the empty glass cleaned

crank.method: round 3: hub centre of the image-tool source, one NN scale
crank.restNote: rest/skip angle 90 (arm pointing right): at 0 (arm up) the arm covers the paw emblem. Spin = restDeg + 360*n clockwise.

capsule.closed: capsule-{tier}.png 192x192 — the game rotates this one sprite while rolling

open.note: frame 5 = skip end state; item is drawn over the capsule (feet in the cup opening), lid leans on the right

hinge.note: 2026-09-24 LAMDiceBot: open frame 5 is drawn as cup + lid hinged at the cup LEFT rim (user: lid on the left, dangling). Lid/cup share the closed-capsule 192 cell coords (centre 96,100).
